query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total_packages FROM packages; SELECT COUNT(*) as packages_yesterday FROM packages WHERE DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(createdAt/1000)) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY); SELECT COUNT(*) as packages_today FROM packages WHERE DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(createdAt/1000)) = CURDATE();
